Full Details

Positioned in a highly convenient East Didsbury location and offered to the market with no onward chain, this well-proportioned three-bedroom home presents an exciting opportunity for buyers looking for generous living space, a sizeable garden and, importantly, the chance to modernise and create a home to their own style.

Offering plenty of scope to improve and add value, the property is ideal for families, first-time buyers, investors or anyone searching for a home they can truly put their own stamp on.

The ground floor provides an excellent amount of living space, with a separate lounge and dining room creating a versatile layout for both everyday family life and entertaining. The lounge benefits from French doors opening directly onto the spacious rear garden, bringing plenty of natural light into the room and providing a great connection between the indoor and outdoor space.

A downstairs W/C adds further practicality, while the property also benefits from an impressive amount of built-in storage space throughout.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, providing plenty of flexibility for a growing family, guest bedroom or dedicated home office.

While the property would benefit from modernisation, this is a home where the potential is immediately apparent. The generous proportions, traditional layout and outdoor space provide an excellent foundation for a buyer to renovate, redesign and potentially add significant value over time.

One of the property's biggest strengths is its position. Situated on Kingsway in East Didsbury, the home is exceptionally well placed for those needing easy access around South Manchester and beyond.

East Didsbury railway station and Metrolink services are within the surrounding area, providing convenient public transport connections, while Kingsway itself offers straightforward access towards Manchester City Centre and the wider motorway network, including the M56 and M60.

The popular Parrs Wood Entertainment Centre is also nearby, offering an excellent selection of leisure and dining facilities including a cinema, bowling, gym and numerous restaurants and eateries.

With Didsbury's amenities within easy reach, excellent transport connections, no onward chain and plenty of potential within the property itself, this represents an exciting opportunity to secure a three-bedroom home in M20 at £350,000 and transform it into something special.

Please Note: As part of our legal obligations under Anti-Money Laundering regulations, we are required to verify the identity of all clients involved in a property transaction. These checks are completed through a third-party provider, and a fee will apply. Please speak to a member of the team for more details.

Property Features

  • Three well-proportioned bedrooms
  • Separate lounge with French doors to the garden
  • Separate dining room
  • Spacious rear garden
  • Upstairs Bathroom and seperate W/C
  • Excellent storage throughout
  • Fantastic scope to modernise and add value
  • Excellent access to East Didsbury tram & railway stations
  • Convenient for the M56, M60 & wider road network
  • No Onward Chain
